title: Tunguska event blamed on the fire god Agdy

tellings.quote: So they believed that the event was caused by their god of fire [snorts] agi coming down from heaven to punish them.

plain: When the Tunguska event struck a remote part of Siberia in 1908, the local people believed it was their fire god, Agdy, coming down from heaven to punish them. A researcher named Randall Carlson tells this, without naming a source, as part of a talk about what the event really was.
